note: The bands the Buzzard Bombshell plant has to land in, from docs/BOMBSHELL-STAGE1.md, which derives each from BMJR's published figures, Cox's figures for the Texaco .049 and the drawn model (scripts/bombshell-derive.js prints the derived figures). Each band is the Slow Stick's in proportion about its derived figure unless its source says otherwise. Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

s1_level_75.source: level speed at 75 percent of the throttle stick, which is 85 percent of the engine's rpm, derived 10.37: the Bombshell's cruise, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e) (APC's 7 x 3 and 7 x 4, half each), was 8.08 on the straight line; the band in the same proportion, 0.860 to 1.165 of it. The neutral elevator still trims at 8.0 m/s (Cm0), which now takes 0.51 of the stick to hold level

s2_stall.source: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax), derived 6.49; alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 1.0 / 4.991, of the zero lift line Re-derived 2026-10-11: alphaStall over the wing's own slope, a_w 4.453 (scripts/bombshell-derive.js), not the wing and tail's 4.991: the stall angle is the wing's and the tail's share lifts on past it, as the Extra's (#935); was 0.20036064917852134. And the band with it: the plant's CLmax is the wing's 1.000 plus the tail's share at that angle, (CLa - a_w) sin a cos a = 0.117, so the formula's speeds go by sqrt(1.000 / 1.117) = 0.9463.

s4_top.source: level speed at full throttle, derived 12.52, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e), was 10.11 on the straight line; the band in the same proportion, 0.910 to 1.123 of it

s5_climb.source: full throttle, best over a sweep of airspeeds the plant flies unstalled, derived 1.77 at 7.56 m/s, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e), was 0.91 at 7.5 on the straight line; the band in the same proportion, 0.681 to 1.198 of it

s6_self_level.source: from a 30 deg bank at cruise, every stick centred: the four state lateral model with the prop's torque and swirl at cruise as a constant input (scripts/bombshell-derive.js, scripts/lib/wash.js propMoments: Q 0.0109 N m, roll -0.0076, yaw -0.0050) gives 13.8, 5.9 and 0.9 deg after 2, 4 and 6 s at the 10.37 m/s cruise (16.5, 10.3 and 6.4 without the prop); re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e), was 14.5, 6.2 and 1.0 at 8.08 m/s on the straight line. Re-derived 2026-10-11 when the plant took the prop's torque from APC's Cp (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md): the band keeps its width in degrees, 4.2 under and 4.3 over, clipped at level, since the derivation's uncertainty is in degrees of bank and a band in proportion about 1 deg would ask a precision it does not have; the bank at 6 s, the same side, and never steeper than it started. Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the combined plant (w36-physics): with the swirl's force on the whole stream, 1/2 rho (u + 2 v_i) (Deters, Ananda and Selig 2015, AIAA 2015-2265, fig. 22b; scripts/lib/wash.js finSwirl), the prop's yaw at cruise grows to N -0.0235 N m and the constant speed model rolls it through level, 7.2, -5.0 and -12.6 deg. It is now flown as the Slow Stick's is (bombshell:derive bankAfterFlown: the speed and pitch with it, the fin in the wash, the prop's torque and swirl at each step's speed): 13.3, 0.3 and -11.9 deg after 2, 4 and 6 s, 8.31 m/s at 6 s, signed on the side it was rolled to. The plant flies 11.6, -2.4 and -14.2 at 8.24 m/s, within 2.7 at all three. Each checkpoint is held to the derived curve within the band's old width in degrees, 4.3, and never steeper than 32; was 0 to 5.2 at 6 s on the same side, which the derivation no longer gives. The plan's built in down thrust is not modelled (docs/BOMBSHELL-STAGE1.md), and no right thrust is recorded for it; a right thrust, if the plan has one, is the term this leaves out.

s7_rudder_bank.source: full right roll stick, which is full right rudder, from level cruise: 67.3 deg after 1 s by the lateral model at the 10.37 m/s cruise, right wing down (re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e): 47.5 at 8.08 m/s on the straight line), the band in the same proportion, 0.609 to 1.519 of it

s8_turn.source: a level 45 deg bank held on the rudder at full throttle: the radius against V^2 / (g tan bank) at the bank and speed flown, the Cub's 15 percent, and the radius itself against the 15.07 m the level turn flies at 12.16 m/s with 0.3 deg of down elevator, within the same 15 percent, and thrown at that speed (re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e): 9.08 m at 9.44 m/s with 5.6 deg up on the straight line, where 90 percent would not hold a level 45 deg bank; on the curve it does, at 11.2 m/s)

s9_stall_power_off.source: Entered 2026-10-11 as FAA-H-8083-3C ch. 5 Full Stalls, Power-Off sets it up, a stabilised idle descent at the normal approach speed, 1.3 times the middle of S2's band, then full up (scripts/*-gates.js S9a quotes it); was entered from cruise, which the prop curves raised by a fifth. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on scripts/lib/liftcurve.js brought up to the plant's sourced model (the wing stalling on its own slope a_w, the tail's share lifting on past it, the finite wing's broadside normal force 1.11 + 0.018 AR of Viterna and Janetzke NASA TM-82944 with B2, where it had the whole aircraft's slope and the infinite plate's 2.0): the full up mush at 14.9 deg, 6.39 m/s sinking 0.865 (was 14.0 deg, 6.83 m/s, 1.225), within 25 percent (was 0.92 to 1.53). full up from cruise, throttle closed, held 8 s: the pitching moment, taken back through the stall (the post stall model of docs/STALL-STAGE1.md, re-derived for crash round 4: until then the flat plate past the stall, 15.6 deg, 8.7 m/s, 3.00 m/s), trims at 14.0 deg of alpha and the aircraft settles into a mush at 6.83 m/s sinking 1.23 m/s, within 25 percent; no wing drop, no yaw that is a spin, the nose never plunging. Re-derived 2026-10-08 on the plant's curve with CL max at its top and the stalled centre of pressure moving aft from the stall (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md, scripts/lib/liftcurve.js): the previous was 15.3 deg, 7.7 m/s, 1.98 m/s The yaw limit is re-derived 2026-10-11 from a spin's definition, autorotation: with the wings inside the bank limit the aircraft only turns, at g tan(bank) / V, so the limit is the turn that bank allows at the mush's measured speed (tests/lib/wingpilot.js turnYawLimitDeg, docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md), where it was 20 deg/s with no source.

s9_stall_power_on.source: re-derived 2026-10-11 to FAA-H-8083-3C ch. 5, Full Stalls, Power-On, quoted in wingpilot.js faaPowerOnStall: held coordinated on the rudder until the stall, recognised and recovered (elevator neutral, wings on the rudder, power kept), never on its back, the wings level within the bank limit by the time the speed is back and held (the handbook returns to the flightpath with sufficient airspeed); was: full up held for the whole run with the wings within 15 deg on the rudder, the prolonged stalled condition the handbook says to prevent, which past the stall a rudder cannot hold since the wing's dihedral share fades (TP-2011 fig. 51). Before: the same with the throttle left at cruise: no wing drop, no spin, no plunge. 2026-10-08 (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md, the stall part 1): flown as the handbook flies a power on stall, the wings held level on the rudder (FAA-H-8083-3C ch. 5); with the slipstream's swirl a tractor turns left there with the rudder left alone. The bands are as they were. The yaw limit is re-derived 2026-10-11 from a spin's definition, autorotation: with the wings inside the bank limit the aircraft only turns, at g tan(bank) / V, so the limit is the turn that bank allows at the mush's measured speed (tests/lib/wingpilot.js turnYawLimitDeg, docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md), where it was 20 deg/s with no source.

s10_phugoid.source: the phugoid root of the four state longitudinal model trimmed at the neutral elevator's 8.0 m/s, derived 5.52, was 5.63 at the 8.08 m/s cruise. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on the prop curves (w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e): the 75 percent level speed moved to 10.37 m/s, but the flight is hands off, so it is flown where the neutral elevator trims, 8.0 m/s (Cm0, unmoved), the 75 percent stick climbing it there; the two coincided on the straight line (8.08 against 8.0) and parted on the curve, so the derivation is taken at the trim the flight is at (bombshell:derive, phugoid at that trim); the band in the same proportion, 0.822 to 1.169 of it

s11_prop_torque.source: static full throttle, rolling left: ideal disc power 0.0197, the 7 x 3.5's shaft power at a power coefficient of 0.035 0.0294

s12_chop.source: throttle to idle from cruise, pitch stick neutral: a glide, not a tumble

s13_throw.source: a throw at 8.5 m/s and cruise throttle with every stick centred, the elevator trimmed for 8 m/s: flying level after three seconds, not sinking out of the hand

s14_rest.source: the drawn model at rest, 8.50 deg and 0.1318 m, 14.0 percent on the skid

s15_takeoff.source: full throttle on grass from standing, flown as the handbook flies a take off (FAA-H-8083-3C ch. 6: the throttle advanced smoothly, the line held on the rudder; tests/lib/wingpilot.js takeoffRoll) and the elevator left alone, re-derived 2026-10-11 from every stick centred when the plant took the prop's torque from APC's Cp and the sticks centred roll became a ground loop, as a real one does; the rudder it takes must be short of full: its three point attitude is past the stall, and the big stabiliser lifts the tail as the speed comes up; derived 11.0 m and 8.0 m/s (re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's curve for the prop (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e), was 17.2 m on the straight line; the distance band in the same proportion, 0.710 to 1.531 of it), the roll tail up to the speed the neutral elevator trims at

s16_landing.source: a glide from 3 m at cruise, flared at half a metre: touches under 1.1 V_s (7.1 m/s) by the Slow Stick's margin, and comes to rest on its wheels and skid at S14's attitude, no hull. The roll out is watched for rollMs from the touchdown (2026-10-11), where the gate had a flat 16 s from the glide's start that no source set: bombshell:derive's roll out from S16's 7.6 m/s, 13.97 s in free air and 14.88 with the ground effect (plant_wing.c GROUND EFFECT, its nose down moment holding the tail off the skid longer), with wing:contact's 10 percent for what the derivation leaves out, 16.4 s. The plant rolled 11.5 s from 4.1 s before the ground effect, a stop at 15.7 s, and about 6 percent longer with it, as derived (6.4)

s17_unmoved.source: the five inch's canonical replay hash and every other aircraft's recorded flight hash in Node, all from main's module at a0d9697, before the Bombshell existed. Re-recorded for crash round 4 aero (#59), from its merged build, with the owner's sign-off on the stall after flying it: sky, cub, glider, bramor, bramorChute, timber, timberf each cross the stall (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md, npm run stall:crossing); the five inch, the wing and the Slow Stick are unchanged The Radian's re-recorded again for crash round 5 on the lead's decision to take its 6 deg FITTED washout (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md), not on an owner's flight: its recording first differs at 7.778 s, in the stall (npm run stall:crossing). Every recorded flight re-recorded again for aero round 6's fix, the table's rotary derivatives applied in the stability axes, one commit per recording from that build, on the owner's approval of the fix on 2026-09-26: each moves short of the stall as well (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md, Round 6). The fixed wings' hashes were re-recorded on 2026-09-27 when their packs and tanks began to drain, the owner's decision (docs/POWER-STAGE1.md); the five inch's is unchanged. Re-pinned for the prop's slipstream and its gyroscope on every prop (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md): the recordings flown under power moved; the five inch's is as it was. Re-pinned 2026-10-12 (w37-flat-fall, the flat fall on its side, plant_wing.c fin_in_wake, the fin's saturated share in its wake loss, the sideslip moments at |cos_b|): bramorChute (was 9302c46f4449de8b): its chute descent meets the flow from behind the wing, past 90 deg, where the sideslip moments no longer turn over. Re-pinned 2026-10-13 (w38-fuselage-side): the recordings that fly sideways moved with their fuselage's crossflow drag taken on the drawn sections, not a round body's (side_cda, NACA TN 3038 through scripts/lib/crossflow.js), and with the AS3X gains re-derived on it (as3x:derive) (were f025098b3e73e796, e414025462e90c74, 0e223d63dcbee9b5, a37fb4874100db9a, 04d5880268b8b3a4). Re-pinned 2026-10-13 (w38-fuselage-side): every recording moved with the fuselage's share of the weathercock taken on Munk's sin 2 beta (NACA TR 184, plant_wing.c MUNK'S MOMENT) where it was on sin beta, and with the AS3X gains re-derived on it (as3x:derive) (were 3b15092bb6cb4c51, 00ce70ac02986c22, f6a79b1d88ee2f86, 18ff2247d729b5e0, 9302c46f4449de8b, 691ec751e6ad5ad9, d36da3cb550a4ea9). Re-pinned 2026-10-13 (w38-fuselage-side): every recording that flies sideways moved with the fuselage's crossflow drag acting at its own centre of pressure (side_x, Allen and Perkins on the drawn sections, NACA TR 1048, ESTIMATED) and the AS3X gains re-derived on it; with side_x out and the AS3X tables as they were every pin holds (were fa8dfc0c627e8b75, 6a437f195866e4ae, 43cc05f101aadb14, 2b6b61e3678a8400, e7a56e9fe45385e5). Re-pinned 2026-10-13 (w38-physics-2): every recording that passes its wing's stall in a slip (a take off's or a landing's roll on its gear at the ground's angle, a stall, a spin) moved with the separated wing's plate force kept normal to the plate, in the plane of symmetry with the lift, where it had gone along the whole wind with a sideways share (plant_wing.c THE PLATE'S FORCE IN A SIDESLIP; NASA TP-1538 table III, the F-16 broadside at 30 deg of sideslip, CY -0.305); unstalled flight is unchanged to the bit (the quad and the 1000 mm wing hold; the Skyhunter's trace first differs at the step its alpha first reaches the stall blend) (were 34d3ceb7759e5db6, 83ec947dcd7f42da, cdad6c21b6a2a557, c803361051a4aeaa, e9c3f06101c6a736, 5cb4a849ded50cd4, 5d388c8140e282f8, f7a510cf9a27a8fa).

s18_cross_host.source: the Bombshell's recorded take off and flight, state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome

s19_thermal.source: a straight pass at cruise through the core of the strongest thermal (2.5 m/s, 45 m, plant_wing.c), pitch stick centred: the aircraft rises with the air, w0 (16/15) R / V = 15.0 m at the neutral elevator's 8.0 m/s trim, was 14.8 m at the 8.08 m/s cruise (Re-derived 2026-10-11 on the prop curves (w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e): the 75 percent level speed moved to 10.37 m/s, but the flight is hands off, so it is flown where the neutral elevator trims, 8.0 m/s (Cm0, unmoved), the 75 percent stick climbing it there; the two coincided on the straight line (8.08 against 8.0) and parted on the curve, so the derivation is taken at the trim the flight is at (bombshell:derive, phugoid at that trim)), against the same flight in still air; the band is 25 percent

s20_idle.source: the throttle closed on the strip: the Cox throttle conversion idles the engine at 40 percent of its rpm, 3,740 of Cox's 9,350, and its 0.45 N of static thrust is under the 0.65 N of rolling and skid resistance, so the engine turns and the wheels' friction holds the aircraft: its ground speed is nil

s21_hands_off_glide.source: level at cruise, then the throttle closed and every stick let go, in Manual: the idle's thrust is nil past 7.0 m/s, 1.27 times its 5.5 m/s pitch speed, where the curve crosses zero (the prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e; the glide is unmoved, Cm0 trimming at 8.0 m/s as before) and the neutral elevator's pitching moment trims the glide at 7.55 deg of alpha, CL 0.658, 7.97 m/s sinking 0.919 m/s (bombshell:derive, hands off glide). The mean of 5 to 15 s, after the phugoid's first cycle; the sink band is S3's in proportion, the speed band S1's, and it never reaches the stall's alpha

stab_letgo.source: bombshell:stab in Manual: 1.5 s of full right roll stick from cruise at 75 percent (the rudder, 75.1 deg on the plant), then every stick let go: the bank 8 s later, right positive. The flown model (bombshell:derive bankAfterFlown from 75.1 deg: the longitudinal model alongside, the lateral model at each step, the fin in the wash, the prop's torque and swirl with its force on the whole stream, scripts/lib/wash.js finSwirl) gives 23.38, 16.09 and -8.86 deg after 2, 4 and 8 s: the prop's yaw rolls it through level. The plant flies 21.42, 20.11 and -7.81 (w36-physics), within 4.02 deg along the curve, the worst at 4 s, where the plant's dive at the let go (8.6 to 14.4 m/s and back to 7.1) is not in a model started from level. Held within 8.0 deg either way: the worst agreement and the same again. Was: under 15 deg with no roll through (above -5), a bound with no derivation, red at -7.8 since the swirl's force at speed (w36-wash-speed 24a09a0d1).

stab_straight.source: thrown level at 8.5 m/s, 30 m up, 0.51 throttle (stab_trim_throttle, the stick stab:glide gives for level), every stick centred in Stabilised: the cross track after 10 s, left positive as the plant's y. Derived (npm run stab:straight, scripts/lib/throwflight.js): the CAP's throw (cap580:derive throwFlight) for this table, the body's six rates at the plant's step on the table's own coefficients, the motor spooled from the throw on its own law and its torque on the mount, right thrust where the table has it, the P factor, the jet normal force, the prop's gyroscope, the slipstream's terms with the swirl's force on the whole stream (scripts/lib/wash.js finSwirl, Deters, Ananda and Selig 2015, AIAA 2015-2265, fig. 22b), and Stabilised's loops with ArduPilot's roll integrator: derived 15.79 m. Against the plant (w36-physics): the cross track within 0.000 m along the curve at 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10 s (plant 15.79 m), the bank within 0.000 deg and the heading within 0.000 deg; with the drive's torque off the mount (sim_wing_set_mount(0)) within 0.000 m of the derived 14.09. Held within 0.01 m either way: the worst agreement of the two and the same again for what the model leaves out (the pack's drain, the ground's effect), and the derived figure's rounding, 0.01 m. Was: under 10 m off the line, a figure with no source, red at 15.8 m since the swirl's force at speed (w36-wash-speed 24a09a0d1). The airspeed at 10 s by the same rule: derived 8.03 m/s, the plant 8.03, within 0.000 along the curve, held within 0.01.
